oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: 05/10/2026 local stand: deleting a site left its job records (whole slabs of its content in `output`) and its provision log on the host, and teardown's 'keeping .../teardown-<label>.log' named a file that did not exist: step 5 used the Python hooks' defaults /var/lib/tracy-jobs and /var/log/tracy-hooks, which the tracy-host container does not have. Red cbdc76842 (both cases not ok on 6c43f9c70), fix e0ed33a26.
